classes.text: HME function is shown: 37 °C / 100% RH target, ~40–50% expiratory recovery, organ-scale heat share. Measurement and safety gating survive. Beneficial-training language does not.
Smoker-derived airway cells: blunted antiviral interferon. Smoke models: higher entry-factor expression, barrier disruption, mucus hypersecretion, ciliary disorder. Injury, not a trained epithelium.
No COVID claim in RAC-CLM-001..060. Current-smoker infection signal is a repeated observation. It cannot become an HME dose-response. RAC-CLM-049 rewrites smoke.
